'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an NPC from the [[Game of Crone]] DLC critical to the ending. She is an inquisitor searching for [[Marquis Teodoro Jr.]] and the other residents of the [[Refugee camp]]. The Keeper first meets her the day after he talks to [[Master Alaric]] about his secret, when she greets him upon waking up and sprays perfume all over [[Sweet Home]] before asking about the refugees. She then vanishes in a flash of pink light.

== Quests ==
Beatrice will ask you to help her raise an army of ghouls by creating [[Emulsion of death]] for her. This decision affects the fate of the refugee camp.
